useCases.title: Bring your own keys, $0 markup
useCases.summary: Attach your provider keys with no per-token cut
useCases.problem: You already pay providers. A second gateway invoice is waste if all you needed was one URL, logs, and failover across the keys you have.

snippets.code:
curl https://anyrouter.dev/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ANYROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "anyrouter/auto",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Say hello in one sentence." }]
  }'
snippets.title: curl · anyrouter/auto

steps: Open /byok and add each provider key.
Call AnyRouter with your sk-ar key. Matching models go out on your BYOK key.
Optionally donate idle quota, or fall through to credits when a key is exhausted.
